answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and called out as confined to the primary region, which is the closest match to the March degradation where regional failover restored latency in minutes and traffic shifted cleanly (memory_b2). Concurrent confounders remain: a release landed ~30 minutes before the climb (rollback historically cleared a checkout spike without customer impact, memory_b1) and settlement writes are at daily peak. Circuit breaking is rejected because it would fail customer writes, which violates the objective. Full regional shift is intended so peak settlement does not remain on the degraded primary; settlement consistency/duplication risk is flagged rather than assumed away. Archives for b2 and b1 are requested to check write-safety at peak and whether rollback was actually a latency (not just error) fix.
